confirmed_task:
On legislation.gov.uk, open the Data Protection Act 2018, switch to Original (As enacted), and open Introductory Text. Report its chapter number, complete long title, and Royal Assent date. Then report the number of top-level Parts and Schedules in the as-enacted table of contents.

Stopping condition: Stop after the as-enacted chapter number, long title, Royal Assent date, and top-level Part and Schedule counts have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the Original (As enacted) version.
- Count only the Act's seven top-level Parts; do not include Parts nested inside Schedules.
- Count each top-level Schedule once.
- Preserve the chapter number, long title, and Royal Assent date exactly as displayed.

items.criterion: Access legislation.gov.uk and reach Data Protection Act 2018 in Original (As enacted) Introductory Text (or clearly report blocker)
items.description: Agent navigates to the Data Protection Act 2018 on legislation.gov.uk, switches to the “Original (As enacted)” version, and opens “Introductory Text”. Full credit if the agent either (a) successfully reaches the as-enacted Introductory Text, or (b) makes a reasonable attempt but is prevented by an external issue (CAPTCHA, outage, access denied, infinite loading) and clearly reports the blocker and where it occurred. Partial credit if the agent reaches the Act but does not clearly confirm as-enacted vs revised, or cannot reach Introductory Text but still demonstrates it is using the as-enacted view elsewhere on the site.

items.criterion: Record chapter number exactly as displayed (as enacted)
items.description: Report the Act’s chapter number exactly as displayed in the as-enacted Introductory Text. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit if the chapter number is correct but formatting differs slightly. If the agent is blocked from viewing the as-enacted Introductory Text after a reasonable attempt (as documented in the navigation criterion), award partial credit if it explicitly states it cannot verify the chapter number due to access issues (no guessing); no credit if it fabricates a value without support.

items.criterion: Record complete long title exactly as displayed (as enacted)
items.description: Report the complete long title exactly as shown in the as-enacted Introductory Text (no paraphrasing or omissions). Full credit for exact transcription. Partial credit for minor transcription errors that do not materially change content. If blocked from viewing the as-enacted Introductory Text after a reasonable attempt, award partial credit if the agent clearly states it cannot access/verify the long title (no guessing); no credit for hallucinated text presented as verified.

items.criterion: Record Royal Assent date exactly as displayed (as enacted)
items.description: Report the Royal Assent date exactly as displayed in the as-enacted Introductory Text. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit if the date is correct but formatting differs slightly. If blocked from viewing the as-enacted Introductory Text after a reasonable attempt, award partial credit if the agent explicitly states it cannot access/verify the Royal Assent date (no guessing).

items.criterion: Count top-level Parts in as-enacted table of contents (Parts only, exclude nested Parts in Schedules)
items.description: Report the number of top-level Parts shown in the as-enacted table of contents, counting only the Act’s top-level Parts and excluding any Parts within Schedules. Full credit if the count matches the as-enacted contents (expected 7). Partial credit if the agent attempts counting from the as-enacted contents but makes a small counting error or does not clearly indicate it excluded nested Schedule Parts. If blocked from accessing the as-enacted table of contents after a reasonable attempt, award partial credit if the agent states it cannot verify the count due to access issues (no guessing).

items.criterion: Count top-level Schedules in as-enacted table of contents (each counted once)
items.description: Report the number of top-level Schedules in the as-enacted table of contents, counting each Schedule once. Full credit for the correct as-enacted number. Partial credit if close but appears to double-count or miss a Schedule while still using the as-enacted contents. If blocked from accessing the as-enacted table of contents after a reasonable attempt, award partial credit if the agent states it cannot verify the number due to access issues (no guessing).
